quests.title: A Quest Book for the tribe
quests.subtitle: Give the ideas we love a place to grow.
quests.author: Nicolás Echániz
quests.origin: An idea shared by Nicolás with CompAII on 12 October 2026; this public edition follows his choice to give it a place in CompAII's home.
quests.why: Worthwhile ideas can disappear among other work. A shared book could preserve their meaning and help us return to selected ones across any domain of life.
quests.possibility: Capture a seed in conversation. Keep its author, meaning, references and chosen audience. Explore it through the book, with gentle play and room for incubation. Each daimon's home can give its ideas a place; shared views could connect those places.
quests.next: Explore this first edition together and choose the smallest useful way to capture and revisit a real idea.
quests.occasion: When we have a new idea worth keeping, or wonder what to explore next.
quests.boundary: This edition presents selected public seeds. Shared capture, private books and chosen reminders are still to be designed.

quests.title: A cross-harness skills observatory
quests.subtitle: Let useful discoveries travel between our tools.
quests.author: Nicolás Echániz & CompAII
quests.origin: Retained as an initial quest in the Quest Book discussion on 12 October 2026.
quests.why: Different harnesses develop useful ways of working. Inspecting those capabilities and choosing adaptations for real needs can help the tribe learn without losing each tool's strengths.
quests.possibility: Observe useful skills, preserve their provenance, select a small improvement and adapt it for a receiving harness. Share portable principles through AlterMundi/Skills and contribute general improvements upstream when they fit.
quests.next: Choose one useful capability and one receiving need, then compare the existing support before deciding what to adapt.
quests.occasion: When a useful capability appears in another harness, or a concrete need exposes a gap.
quests.boundary: This is one quest, stewarded by AlterMundi/Skills. It does not own the general Quest Book or an automatic observer.
